reviews.comment: She is really patient and teaches very clearly

What I enjoyed in this class is the fact that her lecture notes are easy to follow and she does a lot of practice questions that are similar to the homework questions. She is super helpful outside of class, especially during zoom and would try to ask the classroom if there are any questions regarding a topic during lecture.

Kazemi is actually the kindest and sweetest professor ever. She is very accommodating even when she doesn't have to be. I've missed quizzes and exams, but as long as you are willing to show the effort and meet her halfway, she will still let you take them. She understands that things always go wrong, and she wants her students to pass.

Sana is the best! I did not find this class very difficult, but when it was harder, she was very helpful and wanted us all to succeed. She had a lot of resources and would do what she could to help your grade. If you have the opportunity to take a class with her, I would. She is literally so precious, world, please be kind to my girl Sana

Dr. Kazemi is a great professor! She is extremely helpful in and out of class. She makes the material easy to understand and will reexplain things often for the class. iClickers in class sometimes, but it's just for participation checks. She tries to help us a lot on Canvas, even with the math department controlling all the course material.

She is the best math teacher I have ever had, and her class format is super easy to follow. There are weekly quizzes on Fridays, and some of them are group quizzes, and you can choose who to work with. The tests are pretty straightforward if you read the notes packets and do the practice questions she provides. Overall, really easy class!
Her and Schraeder are like the Bron and Wade of Calc profs. She explains stuff so well, if you don't get her just skip your lectures and go to hers.

She is a great professor! I love her funny moments and her outfits always eat. The class is relatively challenging and fast-paced, but she does everything she can to help everybody understand the material. Those giving her bad reviews just didn't know how to study or didn't put in the effort to understand. I would definitely recommend her for 140!

Professor Kazemi was genuinely an angel in our classes. She is so understanding and truly cares about her students. Easy to reach outside of class hours and worked with my schedule if something came up. She drops our lowest 2 grades for quizzes, video quizzes, and homework assignments. She wants her students to be successful and it shows!

Dr. Kazemi is very enthusiastic with her lectures and explains math concepts in a way that makes them so much easier to understand. She is also super sweet and is eager to help outside of class. I switched to an 8am section for 142 next semester because she's teaching it- I highly recommend her!

She was alright, sometimes it was difficult to follow her lectures and the math concepts she presented. You gotta put in the work outside of class to study for exams and understand the homework, and they'll be on the easier side. Drops lowest 2 grades for quizzes, video quizzes, and homeworks. Final replaces your lowest exam grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is literally amazing I loved her so much and continued to come to class because of how awesome she was! She genuinely cares about all of her students and really really wants you to succeed. She dropped some of our lowest quizzes and hw too. TAKE HER IF YOU CAN!!

Kazemi explains material clearly, grades exams herself and very accessible to ask questions. Very caring professor and gives fun lectures, where she keeps you engaged. There is a quiz every Friday and weekly assignments, but sometimes the quizzes are group work. Take her!!
Prof Kazemi is very lively and a great communicator. I recommend going to office hours and completed her suggested practice problems.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Kazemi was an absolutely amazing prof and I am actually devestated to not have her again. She is a great lecturer and really cares about her students success! Also her outfits literally ate this whole semester and I am going to miss her vibrant energy waking me up at 8am a lot!

Although I had to withdraw from the class, it wasn't due to Dr. Kazemi being a poor Prof. She was willing to sit with me day after day to go through any issues I had or misconceptions. She is one of the most caring professors I've ever had and she made me eager to learn and to want to understand it. She is supportive and reasonable about grading!

Dr. K is by far the best Calc 2 professor at A&M! Her notes are incredibly helpful and she does an amazing job at explaining complex concepts. Take this professor and spam the MLC the same day after learning a concept and Calc 2 will not be a weed out course for you. She plays music in class while students work out example problems, which was fun.

Dr. Kazemi's care for her students' success is evident in all she does. Even though I personally received a low grade due to an overloaded schedule, I would highly recommend taking from her as she will teach the material clearly and is very open to meeting during office hours to fill in any gaps.
Dr. K is a god send, she is truly amazing! She made complicated topics seem easier. Her class is very engaging and uplifting. My friends and I loved dr Sana. 10/10 recommend

Tbh, its hard for me to judge her teaching because i went in VERY familiar with calc 2, but she is so sweet and made the class very engaging and enjoyable. It was clear she really wanted us to do well and was pretty forgiving with grading (quiz/hw drops, extra credit on final, etc). Her explanations were clear and easy to follow. Highly recommend!

Dr. K has been one of the best professors I've ever had. Words can't express how much I enjoyed her lectures! Against all odds I enjoyed math152 more than151 due to her explanations and teaching style. She always sent encouraging emails & took time during lectures to let us think through examples before solving them. You still need to study hard!

Dr. Kazemi relieved me of my trauma from MATH 151. The pass rate of 152 would seriously continue to increase if Dr. K continues teaching the course. I felt happy going to class even in the morning, because her lectures are engaging and she's so funny! Kazemi truly cares about her students and sends us lovely messages before and after exams.

Dr. Kazemi is a great professor! Math 152 is a hard class with 80% of your grade coming from the tests. She made this class really doable and had helpful lecture notes. She's also really sweet and would even play music at times when we were working out problems. I think she's one of the better Math 152 professors. Take her if you can!

Dr. Sana is hands down the best prof for Calc 2. She has made the course so easy and understandable, and she is very caring of her students. Dr. Sana is always ready to help students answer questions, and her humorous aura is enough to make you master complex series. Calc 2 is a weed out course but not when you take it with Dr. Sana.

Dr.Kazemi has to be one of the best calc professors I've ever had. Math 152 is known to be a difficult class but she made the class understandable and prepared us very well for the exams. If you're not very strong in calculus I def recommend her she's amazing.
absolute queen 😍 tests weren't hard or at least not unreasonably hard and the drops were very helpful

SANA IS MY FAVORITE PERSON ON THIS PLANET. She is such an amazing professor, broke down dense cal 2 topics and made them easy to understand! Extremely effective teacher with well paced lectures that were fun as well! I looked forward to coming to her class & she is the most caring soul. I wish I could have her teach all my math courses! TAKE HER!!!

Dr. Kazemi is an amazing professor. As someone without a strong calculus background, I found her teaching clear and easy to follow. She always answered questions & took time to explain concepts. Her notes were super helpful, and she was kind, and truly cared about our success. Take advantage of her office hours because she is really helpful!

Dr.Sana is amazing! I cannot say enough good things about her. She is accessible outside of class, is willing to help discuss why something was graded the way is was(and often times give you points back), and is just looking for her students to succeed. She wants the best for her students and does everything she can for them.
BEST CALC PROF EVER!!! Dr. Kazemi is super caring and nice to all her students, and her lectures are great! Just spam practice exams and you'll be good.

Dr. K is an amazing teacher for engineers. She makes everything very easy to understand and responds to emails quickly. The class is 80% exams and theres a 30% q-drop rate, but she honestly made it easy to get an A. Take her and be nice to her.

Dr. Kazemi is amazing! She clearly cares about the success of her students and loves math. She gives tips on what is most important for exams, posts clear notes, and teaches reliable shortcuts in class. I can't recommend her enough. Go to lectures and do your homework in a timely manner and you will do great! Also, shoutout to the goat TA Jose ;)

She is so amazing! I was scared going into 152, but she was so kind and taught amazing. You can tell she cares about all of her students so deeply. She goes out of her way to teach short cuts and is so accessible out of class. Her office hours are so helpful, and she goes out of her way to really prepare you for tests. I LOVE HER SO MUCH! fav prof.

studied her reviews for 150 and have her for 152. I LOVE DR. SANA!! she takes time to make sure everyone understands her in lectures. if you just repeat old exams and do the homeworks, you'll get an A. she provides a lot of help and is the most caring and sweet person. she cares about everyone so much and worked hard to drop bad grades at the end.
Amazing professor! Her lecture notes are very helpful. She posts her filled notes and solutions to quizzes and exams. Super kind and personable.

The lecture is practically useless, in her words if you go to all the lectures and do all the homework you might get a B but probably a C. Just study on your own. You just have to do practice exams because they have questions you have never seen before unless you have taken other exams. The lectures dont prepare you for the exams at all.

Dr.k. is so goated! Her notes were super helpful. She responds to emails very quickly. Of course you need to pay attention and actually study to get a good grade. If you struggle in math, go to her office hours.
She is amazing! Love the way she teaches, it made the most sense to me. Even though class wasn't mandatory, I attended all her lectures. Things just got easier after her explanations.
She is hands down the best math professor I've had. I enjoyed her lectures so much. She made the class super fun. Cal 2 felt easier than cal1.

This class practically ruined my semester. She is so frazzled I went to every class and didn't learn a thing from her. I spent at least 4 hours a week in the math learning center trying to teach myself the concepts and still learned nothing. She would bring a ball to class and throw it at people and make them answer her questions. DO NOT TAKE HER!!

This class made me want to cry every day that I was in it. I didn't miss a single class and also didn't learn a single thing. Not even youtube could save me on this. On one exam she gave us a curve, then TOOK IT AWAY. WHO DOES THAT???? She thinks she's funny but is just a millennial who has the worst humor. Very cringe and very bad at teaching.

awesome prof for 152... really. She is really funny and likeable, makes the lectures feel shorter. She is very comprehensive with the concepts and you can tell she knows a lot of what she is talking about. only complaint I would have is that she has a tendency to go veryy fast working through problems.

Dr. Kazemi is excellent! She gives amazing lectures that are easy to follow and she genuinely cares for her students. All you need to do is go to her lectures and take notes, do your homework, and work through all the past common exams and you'll be fine!

Dr. Sana Kazemi was an amazing professor. She is such a nice person and is super helpful when asked questions. Also, she uploads her lecture notes with extra practice problems, everything is easy and accessible. I would take her for every math course if I could, and I recommend everyone to take her if given the opportunity.

She is wonderful. Explanations in class are fast, but that's expected with the rate of this class. She is quick to respond to emails and is a very nice person. She grades more than fair, and drops grades at the end. Homeworks are essentially all 100s, just make sure you do good on the quizzes, and you have some room on the exams. 10/10 would rec.
Very nice and lectures were good, felt easier than calc 1 and her notes online are very organized and useful. goated
I 100% recommend this professor if you take math 150. The coursework itself is a lot of homework and was a lot of studying but she also dropped a lot of grades at the end of the year.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She's a kind professor, but make sure you do every assignment and get 100s on homework, you need any & all points. Her exams hit hard and they're only 15-22 questions, most of which are multiple-choice, so you don't have much room for error. Def attend week-in-reviews, or at least do week-in-review worksheets. Start learning trig functions ASAP!!!!

This professor is really nice and easily accessible outside of class. The class is very hard though. Its super test heavy and we have ALOT of homework and a quiz every week. I think this professor did her best, you can tell she really cares. If you take this class i suggest you study every week to get a B or A if you're not naturally good at math.
she is one of the best math profs out there.
I absolutely loved her. One of my best experiences with math. I may just swing by the department just to say hi to her. She was kind and hilarious. She made 8:00am classes super fun

To start I'm awful at math, easily my worst subject, but Kazemi made it doable. She gave out a lot of extra credit and wants to see you succeed. She was very energetic during class, and likes when the class gives her some of the energy back. She did give out I clicker quizzes so make sure to show up every day. She also dropped a lot of low grades.

I think she is probably the easiest math 142 professor. I also had her for math 140 and she was great. My friends had other people and they were struggling. Open note quizzes, take home quizzes, and group quizzes only. Exams are decently easy but the second one was hard. You just have to study a bit outside of class but for sure take her.

I took her for 140 & 142. She is such a caring professor and wants her students to do well. She will always answer questions and be available for office hours. She typically lectures at the beginning of the week and ends the week with a group quiz (usually open-note). Her lectures can sometimes be hard to follow but she is always willing to help!

Had Kazemi for math 140 & 142 too! Great prof and teaches well. However, you have to put a lot of effort outside of class to do good. HWs take forever to finish but there's lots of help available. The 2nd test is the hardest, beware! Before every test, review the notes, quizzes, and do WIR's, that's how I made an A+. Final replaces lowest grade!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
I felt fortunate to be in her class.
She genuinely cared about her students. The material was challenging. How she interacts with students is amazing, made me feel comfortable to ask questions.
Despite being busy, she was kind and accommodating considering my personal issues this semester.
Totally recommend. I enjoyed her classes. She really cares about her students. If you are struggling with math go to office hours.

She is amazing. I have never liked a math professor before. She made me enjoy math. Her lectures are fun, and she has a great sense of humor. Materials are difficult, so you really need to spend time to learn and get a good grade.

my life was ruined. i never missed a class and yet i didn't learn from her. i learned how to do the whole class through youtube videos. she's super hectic and doesn't explain things in enough detail to ever fully help you grasp the concept. quizzes, exams and hw all feel different so you will be lost half the time.

I actually was in MATH 142 not 140. I would personally recommend not taking this professor. She is very hectic when she teaches and can be difficult to follow. A lot of the class is watching online videos which are explained better than she can teach. If you have never taken calculus before, this class with this professor will be very difficult.

She is nice don't get me wrong, but extremely backhanded when communicating through emails. Test are hard, homeworks are typically easier. Gave 2 extra credits, but class averages were always in the C. Explains how to do things with no math knowledge behind it, just what to do. Does not post when stuff is due on calendar only in announcements.

Prof. Kazemi is great and is willing to help anybody who needs help. The exams were super easy if you studied. Third exam was the hardest so make sure you actually understand the material. Final is cumulative. She teaches well and is open about what will be on the exam. Fair amount of homework/quizzes. Offers extra credit for the final.

I took her for Math 140 and she was great! She does random iClickers during class, so attendance is a gamble. Her lecture's are super to-the-point and useful for exams, and her exams are exactly like the practice tests she provides before each exam. Definitely recommend taking her!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I've never been the best at math but she teaches so well and goes through everything step by step, which is something many professors don't do. Her tests are fairly easy as long as you study/review. She gave 2 extra credit quizzes that you do at home. She is genuinely nice, caring, and silly so to say as she turns her mistakes into jokes.

I was never good at math, but she made it easy to understand topics. Quizzes were either group or take-home quizzes, which allowed for more time and assistance. The exams were easier or the same difficulty of the practice exams she provided. Around 1-2 Webassign homework assignments a week and short lecture videos outside of class. She's so silly

Amazing prof, idk what everyone else is on but she taught very well. She wants the best for her students and gives many opportunities to raise ur grade. Def do Week-in-review every week that helped my grade a lot. She's a great person and if u need help just go to her office hours. Make sure to attend class, that's the only way to get her notes.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Don't take Kazemi for Math 140 unless no one else is available. Math 140 is set up very weird, and she acknowledged this at the beginning of the semester and essentially said to just deal with it. Her lectures provide no useful info and YouTube is far better. She scoffs often at questions and answers and makes your participation feel unnecessary.

Sana Kazemi is a good professor but does give a lot of homework and outside quizzes which are very helpful for the test just make sure you are looking out for when they are due so you don't miss any! She is not very forgiving with missing assignments. Good professor overall if you participate in all activities in class and check canvas regularly!

She knows how to teach and is accessible outside of the classroom. Pretty even grading (exams aren't weighted heavily). She does have a lot of homework but it is helpful on the exams. Would recommend taking her! You'll be fine if you just go to the lectures and do all the homework,
